title: Manual reviewer attribution must derive from artefact history, not payload reason
answers: Can reviewer reasons be forged when updating a Signals report?
Where is manual reviewer attribution verified against artefact history?
How to prevent spoofed reviewer attribution in Signals report artefacts?
body:
Reviewer attribution must be resolved from historical artefact creators where actor_kind is USER, rather than trusting client-provided reason strings in reviewer payloads.
Enforced in products/signals/backend/report_generation/resolve_reviewers.py:trusted_manual_reviewer_adders during reviewer enrichment.
If skipped, callers updating report reviewer payloads can forge arbitrary "Added as a reviewer by <Name>" reason strings to spoof attribution.
applies: Signals reviewer resolution and artefact attribution in products/signals/backend
says: Report reviewers show forged requester names when updating review requirements
Prevent malicious modification of the person credited with assigning report reviewers
Audit history should verify who actually requested a manual report reviewer
Reviewer assignment history displays incorrect author when report payload is edited
